title: albizia lebbeck
intro: Albizia lebbeck, commonly known as Siris or Black Siris, is a deciduous tree native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia and Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Albizia lebbeck include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Albizia lebbeck include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and provide relief from various health conditions.
